title: Create: Thermobaric
description: A Create addon that introduces new material refinement chains, letting you process common blocks into refined metals and precious gems through crushing, compaction, and extreme heat.
body:
# Create: Thermobaric

Create: Thermobaric is a Create addon that expands the mod's industrial processing with a new material refinement chain, adding raw materials and new refining processes to obtain iron, gold, copper, diamond, and emerald through crushing, compaction, and extreme heat.

## Features

**New Materials**

Carbon Dust and Graphite Ingots are obtained by crushing coal and compacting it under heat, forming the foundation for synthetic diamonds. Beryl Dust and Beryl Ingots are extracted from prismarine shards and used to produce emeralds industrially. Sand, red sand, and mud contain trace amounts of gold, copper, and iron that can be extracted, refined, and reprocessed.

**From Impure to Pure**

Nothing goes to waste. Impure ingots and gems can be crushed back into dust and reprocessed, giving you a second chance at obtaining pure results.

**New Storage Blocks**

Graphite and Beryl blocks for compact storage, fully compatible with Forge tags.

**Full Create Integration**

Every recipe is built around Create's machinery, including crushing wheels and heated or superheated basin compacting.

## Requirements
- [Create](https://modrinth.com/mod/create) (required)
